newsitem.title: FRANCE: U.N. envoy briefs Algeria on Sahara dispute.
newsitem.headline: U.N. envoy briefs Algeria on Sahara dispute.

text.p: Algerian Foreign Minister Ahmed Attaf held talks with a United Nations envoy on Sunday about a stalled peace plan for Western Sahara, the official Algerian news agency APS reported.

Eric Johnson of Britain, the secretary general's special envoy for Western Sahara, briefed Attaf on the latest U.N. report to the Security Council on the deadlocked plan, APS said. It gave no further details.

The plan, under which a referendum on self-determination for the former Spanish colony should have been held in January 1992, has yet to be implemented because of disputes over who should be entitled to vote.
Morocco claims sovereignty over the territory where guerrillas of the Polisario Front have fought for independence.
